name: Dimethylionone
description: Dimethylionone (CAS 68555-94-2 ) is a synthetic fragrance and flavoring ingredient prized for its rich, woody-violet character with subtle fruity and orris-like nuances. It belongs to the ionone family and is used by perfumers and flavorists as a fixative and character-building material in finished formulations for various industrial applications. In fine fragrance and personal care, this compound anchors floral and powdery accords in perfumes, body lotions, and hair care products, providing depth and longevity to the scent profile. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into skin care and color cosmetics where a soft violet-woody background note is required to enhance the overall sensory experience for the consumer. In flavor applications, it contributes to berry, fruit, and floral flavor profiles used in confectionery, beverages, and dairy products, meeting strict food-grade quality requirements. It also appears in functional personal care formats such as deodorants and fabric conditioners, where its substantivity supports long-lasting fragrance performance on surfaces and textiles. The material is supplied as a liquid, typically at high purity levels suited to fragrance and flavor manufacturing, ensuring consistent results across different production batches. It is available in fragrance-grade and flavor-grade specifications, with flavor-grade material conforming to relevant food safety standards required by global flavor houses and food manufacturers.
